items.prompt: We’ve seen that we can convert a number from fraction form into decimal form.  52/100  0.52  We can also convert number in decimal form into fraction form. My turn first: here is 0.52. There are two digits to the right of the decimal point, so these are hundredths. Fifty-two hundredths.
Watch what I change. Three digits to the right of the decimal point, so five-hundred twenty-nine thousandths.
Watch what I change again. Two digits to the right of the decimal point, so two hundredths.
items.demo: Two hundredths: *2/100*. Each time, the digits go on top. Then, the number of digits to the right of the decimal point tells us how many zeroes to write on the bottom.

items.expected: No. 0.5 is five tenths and 0.05 is five hundredths. The column the five sits in decides its value.
